page: Amazon Web Services m8i-flex.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor. It features 64 vCPUs and 32 physical cores based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor running at 3.9 GHz. The compute architecture includes a massive 480 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for accelerated vector and matrix operations.

The instance is equipped with 256 GB of high-speed DDR5 memory operating at 7 GHz, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. While the server does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, it delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps. The hardware profile offers strong resource density, making it a cost-efficient option for workloads requiring modern memory speeds and high-throughput compute without the overhead of local NVMe drives.

Benchmark results highlight top-tier performance in single-core processing, image processing, and static web serving throughput. Multi-core performance, database operations, and large-block memory read bandwidth also rank in the top 25%. Additionally, the hardware-assisted matrix extensions enable strong performance in large language model prompt processing. This server is highly suited for enterprise web serving, database operations, software compilation, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
